marine_forecast.name: Tidal Potomac from Key Bridge to Indian Head MD
marine_forecast.forecast_text:
Tidal Potomac from Key Bridge to Indian Head-
758 AM EDT Sun Mar 15 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH MONDAY AFTERNOON...
...GALE WATCH IN EFFECT FROM MONDAY AFTERNOON THROUGH LATE MONDAY
NIGHT...

.TODAY...E winds 5 to 10 kt with gusts to 25 kt...becoming SE 15 kt
with gusts to 25 kt late. Waves 1 ft. 
.TONIGHT...SE winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming S late. Gusts up to
25 kt. Waves 1 ft. Showers. Vsby 1 NM or less. 
.MON...S winds 15 to 20 kt. Gusts up to 20 kt... increasing to 35 kt
in the late morning and afternoon. Waves 2 ft. Showers with a chance
of tstms. Vsby 1 NM or less. 
.MON NIGHT...W winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 35 kt. Waves 1 ft.
Showers with a chance of tstms. 
.TUE...W winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.TUE NIGHT...NW winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 25 kt...diminishing
to around 5 kt after midnight. Waves 1 ft.
.WED...S winds around 5 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.THU...SE winds around 5 kt. Waves 1 ft.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.

advisories.label: Gale Watch
advisories.headline: Gale Watch issued March 15 at 7:43AM EDT until March 17 at 1:00AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
advisories.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, southeast winds 10 to 20
kt with gusts up to 30 kt and waves 2 to 4 ft expected. For
the Gale Watch, southwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to
35 kt and waves 2 to 4 ft possible.

* WHERE...Tidal Potomac River from Key Bridge to Smith Point VA,
and Chesapeake Bay and adjoining estuaries north of Smith
Point VA.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 1 PM EDT Monday.
For the Gale Watch, from Monday afternoon through late Monday
night.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous waves which could
capsize or damage vessels.
advisories.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and waves.
